_comment: The Guild Hall clerks' lines. npcgen builds them into the hall's plugin: one player topic, 'I have guild business.' (AG's own prompt), and each clerk's reply opens the Guild counter (AG_TIF_GuildBusiness -> AG_Native.ActionOpenCounter), so it shows the hall's view. business = the plain line (ranks E-D, and any rank without its own line); extra = any rank; byRank = the player's rank. Keys are stable: they pin each line's INFO ID, which names its voice file.

AGHallClerkDay.business: Hello, hello! Come for more work, or are you ready to hand a job in?
extra: Good to see you. Now then, what are we doing today?
Welcome back! What can I do for you, I'm all ears.

byRank.C: There's a familiar face. Got a report for me or a trophy to sell?
byRank.B: One of my favourites! How can I help you today?
byRank.A: Pride of the hall, as ever. What can I do for you?
byRank.S: Skyrim's finest adventurer at my counter. How can the Guild help you?

AGHallClerkEvening.business: Welcome! Looking for something? I'll help however I can.
extra: Of course! Something to hand in, or a new job?
It's nice to see you again. What can I help with?

byRank.C: Hello again! You're a welcome sight. How can I help?
byRank.B: Welcome back! I'll be quick, I promise. How can I help?
byRank.A: Oh! It's you! Right, yes. What can I do for you?
byRank.S: Oh, welcome back! It's an honor, truly. Please let me know what I can do for you.

_topics: The clerks' guild business at the hall counter (2.0): register, promote, card replacement and card hand-in, as the innkeepers' (AG config/dialogue.json), built by npcgen into AGHallClerkTopicRegister/RegisterPay/RegisterLater, Promote/PromotePay/PromoteLater, Replace and CardHandIn, in their own ID block. registerAsk / promoteAsk name the fee; register / promote are said once it is paid (they act: AG's DLL registers or promotes); *Later answer Not now.; *Nofee when the player has not the gold; replace acts (a new card) and does not end the conversation; cardHandIn:<case> by AG_CardCaseGlobal (alive 1, dead 2, fallen 3, worn 4). cardHandIn:<editor ID>: her own line for one of the hall folk she knew (Willem and the five residents), when that dead or fallen member's card comes in (AGHallCardOwnerGlobal, set by AG's DLL).

AGHallClerkDay.registerAsk: Ah, a recruit! I do love this part. There's just the Guild's fee, and then we'll get you your card.
AGHallClerkDay.register: There. Your guild card, and welcome to the Adventurers Guild. I'm Margot by the way, it's a pleasure to meet you. Be safe out there and if you come back with a story, I'll want every word of it.
AGHallClerkDay.registerLater: No rush. The Guild isn't going anywhere.
AGHallClerkDay.registerNofee: Not quite enough coin. Bring the full amount and we'll do it properly.
AGHallClerkDay.promoteAsk: I've heard what you've been up to, you know. And from the sounds of it, the rank's yours. There's only the fee first.
AGHallClerkDay.promote: It's done. Here's your updated card, and I'll be telling people about this one. Congratulations!
AGHallClerkDay.promoteLater: Fair enough. You've earned it and the promotion will be here when you're ready.
AGHallClerkDay.promoteNofee: Short of coin? It happens. Come back with the fee, and we'll see it done.
AGHallClerkDay.replace: Lost to a troll, or to a card game? Never mind. Here's a new one.
AGHallClerkDay.replaceNofee: I'd love to, but the Guild charges for a new card. Bring me enough gold and I'll issue you a replacement.
AGHallClerkDay.cardHandIn:alive: Thank you. They'll be glad to have this back, and a little embarrassed.
AGHallClerkDay.cardHandIn:dead: I'll take it, and thank you. We'll try to let their family know as well.
AGHallClerkDay.cardHandIn:fallen: Oh, no. I'm sorry. Leave it with me. Their kin will be told if you haven't already let them know yourself. Your fallen party member will be remembered here.
AGHallClerkDay.cardHandIn:worn: Worn right through. Still, I know most of our people by now. I'll try to work out whose it was.
AGHallClerkDay.cardHandIn:AGHallGuildMaster: Willem's card. Give it to me, please. Whoever writes his name in the book, it should be me.
AGHallClerkDay.cardHandIn:AGHallResidentVeteran: Marius's. He came home from a war, and from every job after it. I'll write this one in my best hand.
AGHallClerkDay.cardHandIn:AGHallResidentRanger: Ylva's. She took the hunts no one else would. I'll see her pay goes where she'd want it, if I can work out where that is.
AGHallClerkDay.cardHandIn:AGHallResidentOrc: Ghrulek's. It'll be a quiet hall without him. Someone else will have to buy the rounds now, and nobody will do it as loudly.
AGHallClerkDay.cardHandIn:AGHallResidentScout: Zhasim's. He knew every road in Skyrim. I'll ask Merila to mark the last one he walked.
AGHallClerkDay.cardHandIn:AGHallResidentNoble: Caralion's. I won't pretend I'll miss him. But I'll write it in the book properly, the same as anyone's.

AGHallClerkEvening.registerAsk: Really? Oh, good! There's just a small fee to sign you on. Is that all right?
AGHallClerkEvening.register: Done! Your very own guild card. Here you go. Oh, I'm so glad for you. Good luck, welcome to the guild, and be careful.
AGHallClerkEvening.registerLater: Of course. Come back any time, really.
AGHallClerkEvening.registerNofee: Oh. It's the fee, I'm afraid. I'm sorry. Can you come back with enough to cover it?
AGHallClerkEvening.promoteAsk: Yes! Yes, you've earned it. It only needs the fee, and I'll update your card.
AGHallClerkEvening.promote: There! Your new card. Congratulations, truly. Thank you for letting me be the one to do it.
AGHallClerkEvening.promoteLater: Take your time! It's yours whenever you want it.
AGHallClerkEvening.promoteNofee: I wish I could waive it, I really do. Come back when you have the fee?
AGHallClerkEvening.replace: Here you are, a fresh card. Any stamps will need doing again, I'm sorry. Come back if you ever need another one.
AGHallClerkEvening.replaceNofee: I can't without the fee, and I hate saying no. When you have it, I'll make one.
AGHallClerkEvening.cardHandIn:alive: Oh, they must be missing this. Thank you. I'll see they get it.
AGHallClerkEvening.cardHandIn:dead: I'm sorry. Thank you, thank you for not leaving this out there. I'll see their family knows.
AGHallClerkEvening.cardHandIn:fallen: Oh by the gods, they were in your party weren't they?... I'm so sorry. Please, let me take care of it. You've done enough.
AGHallClerkEvening.cardHandIn:worn: Poor thing, it's been through a lot. I'll ask around; someone here might know whose it was. Thanks for bringing it in.
AGHallClerkEvening.cardHandIn:AGHallGuildMaster: That's Willem's. He's the one who took me on... I'm sorry. I need a moment before I can write it down.
AGHallClerkEvening.cardHandIn:AGHallResidentVeteran: Marius? He told me my footwork was a disgrace, every single time. I'm going to miss that.
AGHallClerkEvening.cardHandIn:AGHallResidentRanger: Ylva... No. She was the best of all of them. I'm going to keep practising. Somebody has to.
AGHallClerkEvening.cardHandIn:AGHallResidentOrc: Ghrulek? He was always so loud. I don't know what the hall sounds like without him.
AGHallClerkEvening.cardHandIn:AGHallResidentScout: Zhasim's? He always made me laugh. Even on the late shift. Especially then.
AGHallClerkEvening.cardHandIn:AGHallResidentNoble: Caralion's? I never liked him. I still didn't want this. I'll see it's written down.

_replies: The clerks' replies to "I have guild business.": one of three at random, then the counter opens. With them, the clerks' business / extra / byRank lines become her greeting when the player clicks on her during her shift (npcgen: AGHallClerkTopicHello).

AGHallClerkDay: There. The counter is all yours.

_voiceTypes: A voice type of the clerk's own (Margot first, as a test): her takes live under it (move_voice.py), and vanilla's generic lines reach her in her own voice (vanilla_lines.json).
_greetings: Her own click greetings off shift (helloOff) and to someone not yet a member (helloNew), and her goodbyes, in place of vanilla's. A walk-by still gets vanilla's walk-by hellos, in her voice.

helloOff: Hello, you. Something on your mind?
I'm off duty, but I don't mind talking with you.
Hey there. How are you doing?
helloNew: Hello! Here to join, or just passing through?
Not a member yet, are you? The Guild's always recruiting.
goodbye: Off you go, then. Good luck and stay safe out there!

helloOff: Oh! Sorry, I was miles away. Hello.
Hello! It's nice to see you away from the counter. Have you been anywhere exciting recently?
I'm not working right now, but ask me anything you like.
helloNew: Thinking of joining the guild? I'd love to sign you up.
Oh, hello! You look like an adventurer. Come to join?
goodbye: Tell me everything next time you're back!

_about: The clerks' answers to AG's own 'What's Guild work like around here?' at the hall: one of three at random.

AGHallClerkDay: Better than High Rock, I'll tell you that. In Wayrest it was all escort work. Here? Barrows, giants, trolls. Proper adventuring.
Busy! Draugr at Dustman's Cairn, sabre cats in the hills, giants on the plains. Pick your poison.
I heard there's a tower crossing, out along the White River where bandits charge a toll to cross the bridge. I'd love one of ours to end that.
AGHallClerkEvening: Bleak Falls Barrow looms right over Riverwood. People ask about it all the time. I tell them to take torches. Lots of torches. Oh and good armor... and weapons of course! And potions too!
Bandits, mostly. Embershard Mine's full of them, just off the road, and there are more at Halted Stream Camp. Please don't go alone.
Trolls and frostbite spiders in the hills, and giants out on the plains. I saw one from the road once. It was as big as a house!

_aboutSolitude: The Solitude site's versions of the clerks' about lines, by the line number they stand in for: each plays only at site 2 (AG_GuildHallSiteGlobal), its Riverwood line then only elsewhere. unlessDone: a quest whose completion ends the line.

AGHallClerkDay.2: Plenty. Bandits a stone's throw up the road, hagravens to the north, trolls in the snow.

3.text: Folk in Solitude talk about lights in Wolfskull Cave, just west of us. I'd love one of ours to look into it.

AGHallClerkEvening.1: You can see the Thalmor Embassy from our door. I don't go near it. Please don't do anything brave up there.
AGHallClerkEvening.2: Hagravens at Ravenscar Hollow, north of here. Even the drawings frighten me. Please don't go alone.
AGHallClerkEvening.3: Trolls and sabre cats up in the snow. I saw a troll from the road once. Big as a cart!

_idles: What each clerk says to herself when the player is in her line of sight, in her waking hours: one of six at random, each waiting four game hours, with a 1% chance a line so she speaks about every four minutes.

AGHallClerkDay: Skyrim's next S-rank. Could walk in any time.
Somebody's bound to come back with a troll story.
Now, who's still out on the road?
Every member's best day, and their worst. I know both.
Divines watch over the new ones.
AGHallClerkEvening: One day I'll have my own stories to tell.
So many places I haven't seen.
Imagine walking into a dragon's lair.
Next time, I won't freeze up.
I wonder if that story was true.

_afterHours: Off shift, her one answer to 'I have guild business.' (and to a non-member's join): otherClerk while the other clerk works, closed 22-6. Neither opens the counter.

AGHallClerkDay.otherClerk: Nessa has the counter now. Go on, she'll look after you.
AGHallClerkDay.closed: Sorry, not at this hour. The counter opens again at six.

AGHallClerkEvening.otherClerk: Sorry! I don't start until midday. Margot can help you right now though.
AGHallClerkEvening.closed: We've closed, I'm sorry. Could you come back at six?

_chats: The counter exchanges: scenes between the clerks while their shifts overlap, 12-16, each at most once a game day. needs: people the exchange names; it plays only while they are alive and in the hall.

lines.text: Sorry! I just like hearing them come in.
I know, love. So do I.
Henriette will have your hide. Go on, I'll mind the counter.
Did he, now. Then be very polite to him. It drives him mad.
Zhasim showed me a new cave on Merila's map.
And now you want to go.
Straighten up. You're the Guild's face, remember.
Lovely, but distracted like your mind is somewhere else.
Oh sorry! You're right, I'm here and focused now!
